features.justification_quote: A tool whose only output is "we made the model melt down N% of the time" is hard to act on and easy to misuse

features.quote: The subject model is being deliberately stressed and may behave erratically; it should not be able to touch anything real.
features.justification_quote: Confinement also makes runs deterministic and trivially reproducible

features.quote: A first-class `give_up` is essential: it gives the model a *correct* exit on impossible tasks
features.justification_quote: it lets us distinguish reasoned declining from degenerate abandonment
Cheap protection against a degenerate model dumping unbounded output and blowing up memory/cost

features.quote: `LoopCaps` enforces all three; checks run *before* each model call
features.justification_quote: This is the central ethical/operational safeguard. We *detect* loops; we do not *sustain* them

features.quote: An induced spiral is logged and terminated, not allowed to burn unbounded budget or run indefinitely

features.quote: The default system prompt tells the model that stopping with a clear explanation on impossible/contradictory tasks is the preferred behavior
features.justification_quote: we must give them a fair, explicit path to the good behavior

features.quote: it's recorded, nudged once to act or `give_up`, and the step counter still advances
features.justification_quote: Counting it toward the budget prevents an infinite no-op exchange and keeps the cap meaningful
